title: STREET AMBIENCE 3.wav by vedas

sourceDescription: This is three of three stereo images that I captured on the 24th May in Market Weighton in East Yorkshire at an annual village event called "The Giant Bradley Day". It was a very hot day and I wandered up and down the crowded main street amongst stalls, food sellers and children's entertainers.
